BrochureContent.Content:
REA Brady are delighted to present this impressive and beautifully maintained bungalow residence, ideally situated on a large private site of just over 2 acres in the peaceful and sought-after area of Drumcong, just 18km from the bustling town of Carrick-on-Shannon and approximately 9.5km to Drumshanbo. This home offers the perfect mix of countryside living with great convenience, being just minutes from schools with National School and Playschool in nearby Drumcong , shops, sporting facilities all within a short distance.
Tastefully decorated and presented in very good condition, the property has the benefit of a large site with lots of room to extend (subject to necessary consents), concreted area, driveway and landscaped gardens with base in place for a detached garage. There is plenty of space for outdoor entertaining and for the gardener a huge area or for those who love to be self sufficient plenty of space for a polytunnel. This home is perfectly suited to families, downsizers or anyone seeking a relaxed lifestyle with easy access to many amenities.
Internally there is a great layout with living room to the front with solid fuel stove, off this is a combined kitchen and dining area ideal for entertaining and family gatherings with solid fuel stove also in kitchen which has the benefit of a back boiler. There is a separate utility room and this leads to the rear of the house. All four bedrooms are good double rooms, laid out with comfort and functionality in mind, each benefiting from built-in wardrobes with lots of storage space while maintaining floor space and furnishing options. The bungalow has bathroom with large shower and is fully tiled. 
Externally, the property stands on a very large site of circa 2 acres with concrete driveway and lots of parking and has great potential. A concreted driveway and ample off-street parking surround the house, with concrete base in place for a garage. There is a boundary hedge that offers privacy. To the rear and both sides and front is a substantial garden ideal for gardening lovers, kids and family use or a variety of other uses. 
Located less than ten minutes from Drumshanbo and approximatley 15 minutes to Carrick on Shannon with a range of activities located in both towns and Ballinamore also a short drive away. There is an excellent selection of schools in Drumcong (National School), Ballinamore, or Drumshanbo or Carrick on Shannon. This property really does offer its new owners the perfect balance of location, great site and gardens, modern comfort and convenience. Contact us to organise a viewing of this great property and viewing is Strictly by appointment only.
